title: URL Shortener
description: A URL shortening application that transforms long URLs into shorter, manageable links.
problem: Long URLs can be difficult to share, manage, and use.
solution: Built a URL shortening application with separate frontend and backend components.

title: Huffman Encoder
description: A file compression and decompression application based on the Huffman coding algorithm.
problem: Files can contain redundant information that can be represented more efficiently.
solution: Implemented Huffman coding to compress and decompress files through both graphical and terminal interfaces.

title: ML Model Deployment
description: An employee attrition prediction application that makes a machine learning model accessible through Flask.
problem: Understanding employee attrition patterns can help HR teams make better-informed decisions.
solution: Built a Flask application to expose an employee attrition prediction model.

title: Booking Scraper
description: A web scraping project that extracts hotel information from Booking.com and stores it in JSON format.
problem: Collecting hotel information manually can be repetitive and time-consuming.
solution: Automated the extraction of hotel names, ratings, and amenities from Booking.com.

title: Terminal Chess
description: A two-player chess game implemented in C with standard chess rules and a terminal-based interface.
problem: Implementing a board game requires representing its state and enforcing its rules correctly.
solution: Developed a terminal-based chess game for two players.

title: Simple News Analyzer
description: A web application that analyzes the sentiment of online news articles using the MeaningCloud API.
problem: Understanding the sentiment expressed in an article requires analyzing its text.
solution: Built a web application that uses MeaningCloud to analyze article sentiment, including polarity and subjectivity.
